question: The average of first 156 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first n even numbers is directly given by the formula (n + 1).

Given the number of terms, n = 156.

⇒ Average = 156 + 1 = 157

**∴ The correct answer is 157.**
